The true and false section is a bit tricky, but attempting many practice tests, this can be easily overcome. The beginning section is very easy and test takers mostly score good in it. The later section tests a lot of your knowledge as you cannot hope to ace it just by memorisation. it requires you to understand the concepts thoroughly.
